SELECT cat.CategoryID,
       cat.CategoryDescription,
       COUNT(ss.StudentID) AS completed_grades,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ss.StudentID) AS completing_students,
       COUNT(st.StudentID) AS matched_student_rows,
       COUNT(ss.Grade) AS nonnull_grades,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ss.Grade) AS distinct_grades
FROM main.Categories AS cat
LEFT JOIN main.Subjects AS sub ON sub.CategoryID = cat.CategoryID
LEFT JOIN main.Classes AS c ON c.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
LEFT JOIN main.Student_Schedules AS ss ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID AND ss.ClassStatus = 2
LEFT JOIN main.Students AS st ON st.StudentID = ss.StudentID
WHERE cat.CategoryID = 'ENG' OR cat.CategoryDescription LIKE '%English%'
GROUP BY cat.CategoryID, cat.CategoryDescription

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        st.StudLastName,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY ss.Grade DESC) AS rank_fraction
    FROM main.Student_Schedules AS ss
    JOIN main.Students AS st ON st.StudentID = ss.StudentID
    JOIN main.Classes AS c ON c.ClassID = ss.ClassID
    JOIN main.Subjects AS sub ON sub.SubjectID = c.SubjectID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
      AND sub.CategoryID = 'ENG'
)
SELECT
    StudLastName,
    CASE
        WHEN rank_fraction <= 0.20 THEN 'First'
        WHEN rank_fraction <= 0.40 THEN 'Second'
        WHEN rank_fraction <= 0.60 THEN 'Third'
        WHEN rank_fraction <= 0.80 THEN 'Fourth'
        ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS Quintile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank_fraction, StudLastName
LIMIT -1
